lines.trans: It looks like senior company executives and officials have all come to visit you.
Let us slip out quickly before they come upstairs.
How could we do that—you are still so weak right now, no way!
Sneaking past the nurses made me a little tense, and now my stomach feels uncomfortable.
You have stomach medicine at home, right?
Yes, I do—come on in.
Feel free to check the kitchen; there might be something to eat in the fridge.
It is fine, I am not hungry—I will sit over there and keep watch over you.

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，下次见！
examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!

examples.text: 他的习惯是不带实习生的。
examples.trans: His habit is never taking on interns.

examples.text: 也许从一开始，他就没打算过用我。
examples.trans: Maybe right from the beginning, he never intended to use me.

examples.text: 他也许还在录影棚里忙。
examples.trans: Perhaps he is still busy in the studio.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 我看他们太忙了，就想上去帮把手。
examples.trans: I saw they were too busy, so I wanted to step up and lend a hand.

examples.text: 你可以去厨房看看，冰箱里也许有吃的。
examples.trans: Check the kitchen—there might be something to eat in the fridge.

examples.text: 休息室的冰箱里备好了矿泉水和三明治。
examples.trans: Bottled water and sandwiches are stocked in the lounge fridge.

examples.text: 我刚刚是不是太没礼貌了？
examples.trans: Was I way too impolite just now?

examples.text: 我刚刚是不是太没礼貌了？
examples.trans: Was I way too impolite just now?

examples.text: 他干脆让厨房多做些鱼给大家吃。
examples.trans: He told the kitchen to cook plenty more fish for everyone.
Delicious aromas drifted from the kitchen.

examples.text: 我放弃电视台，去星天娱乐。
你也不用太悲观了，可以试试云海卫视。
examples.trans: You do not need to be too pessimistic either; you can try Yunhai Television.
The hotpot is ready — eat up!

examples.text: 我还约了人，你们先回去吧。
examples.trans: I also have an appointment with someone; you two head back first.

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 李先生好像很满意小谷的安排。
examples.trans: Mr Li seems pleased with Xiaogu's arrangements.

examples.text: 我不饿，我就坐在这儿安安静静守着你。
examples.trans: I am not hungry—I will sit right here keeping watch over you.

examples.text: 技术人员在机房守了一整夜，确保播出安全。
examples.trans: Engineers stood watch in the server room all night for safe airing.

meanings.note: At home or within one's household.

examples.text: 我家里今天临时有点急事，想请半天假。
examples.trans: Something urgent came up at home today, so I need half a day off.

examples.text: 给家里打个电话，免得父母担心。
examples.trans: Call home so your parents do not worry.

examples.text: 星天有很多部门，这些部门之间都是平行的。
examples.trans: Xingtian has many departments, and all of these departments are on equal footing.

examples.text: 老师，我稍微感觉有点失望。

meanings.note: everyday phrase meaning unhurt or 'it is nothing'

examples.trans: Are you alright? I am Bu Xiaogu.

examples.text: 我没事，休息一会儿就好了。
examples.trans: I am fine; I will be alright after resting a bit.

examples.text: 我看他们太忙了，就想上去帮把手。
examples.trans: I saw they were too busy, so I wanted to step up and lend a hand.

examples.text: 见什么都要看看，不好意思啊。
examples.trans: Whatever I see, I cannot help taking a look — sorry about that.

examples.text: 不要老想着自己是实习生没经验。
examples.trans: Stop always thinking that you are an intern with no experience.

examples.text: 我离开化妆间的时候，他还没上台。
examples.trans: When I left the dressing room, he had not gone onstage.

examples.text: 请不要随便离开工作岗位。
examples.trans: Please do not leave your post casually.

examples.text: 我去那儿当实习生，就能上十二歌王的组。
你刚输完液身体还这么虚，怎么能乱跑呢！
examples.trans: You are still so weak right after your drip—how can you run off!

examples.text: 大病初愈身子虚，这礼拜千万别再熬夜审片了。
examples.trans: Recovering from illness leaves you weak; no late-night edits this week.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
趁来看望的高层还没上楼，咱们赶紧离开。
examples.trans: Before the visiting executives come upstairs, let us slip away!

examples.text: 趁着天还没黑，外景组抓紧补拍了最后两个镜头。
examples.trans: While daylight held, the field crew grabbed the final two shots.

examples.text: 这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
examples.trans: These files, plus these four hundred hours of video recordings.
Do you trust me this much?

meanings.note: directional compound verb moving toward the speaker inside

examples.trans: Who told you to come in?
That would be wonderful, thank you!

examples.text: 我去那儿当实习生，就能上十二歌王的组。

examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.
There is lots of work in the company.
There is someone in the lounge.

examples.text: 最重要的部门还是这边，淳于乔领导的制作部。
examples.trans: Still, the most important department is right here: the production unit led by Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 没事，我现在还不饿，就在这儿守着你。
examples.trans: It is fine, I am not hungry right now—I will stay watching over you.

examples.text: 忙完直播才半夜十二点，大家突然觉得肚子好饿。
examples.trans: Wrapping the live show at midnight, everyone suddenly felt starving.

examples.text: 高层在会议室里开了好几个小时会。
examples.trans: Senior executives met inside for several hours.

examples.text: 公司高层非常重视这次直播。
examples.trans: Senior management values this live broadcast highly.
